lydia_cs: Quick heads-up: Parallax QBR in ~10 days. Need a single cost slide covering 90d token burn, 30/60/90 forecasts, any embedding outliers, and two concise remediation options we can propose (short-term cache + cadence change). Who can own numbers?

zoe_finops: I can take numbers. quick read shows a spike Mar 10-12 that pushed their run-rate up. rough current run-rate ~ $11.8k/mo. I'll produce 30/60/90 CSV by EOD tomorrow.

miguel_ops: cache check: prefix KV cache is enabled on their main text route; embedding cache retention is unset. enabling a 7-day embedding retention in our sim takes about 15% cost off the run-rate. I can validate staging change tomorrow AM.

sanjay_se: traced three large embed jobs to dataset-sync pipeline (owner: data-team-batch). They run nightly full re-embeds at 02:00 UTC. Recommend shifting to weekly full + daily incremental or adding batch-size caps.

cleo_cs_manager: action list: Zoe -> finalize CSV + projections by EOD tomorrow. Miguel -> staging cache toggle + sim results by tomorrow 11am. Sanjay -> propose job cadence and draft a one-line request for data-team-batch to review. Lydia -> draft the QBR slide (1 page) with current vs cache vs cadence vs combined.

lydia_cs: noted, I'll assemble slides after Zoe's numbers. scheduling 30min enablement call with Parallax for Wed 10am PT to run through options.

parallax-bot: usage-export: https://redwood-reports.internal/usage/parallax/2798765432 (report id b9c3)

zoe_finops: provisional projection table (for slide): current -> $11.8k/mo; cache-only -> $9.9k/mo; cadence-only -> $8.8k/mo; combined conservative -> $8.3k/mo. Will refine with token-level CSV.

miguel_ops: note for slide: if customer considers Dedicated commit, include a commit vs hosted comparison over 12 months. that changes the unit math significantly.

cleo_cs_manager: perfect. Zoe/Miguel/Sanjay sync tomorrow 11am PT, Lydia to finalize slide pack by Thur COB. I'll prep the enablement agenda. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
